[!dolt] skip
# Test bd show in text and JSON modes
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'Test issue for show' --description 'Detailed context' --json
extractid ISSUE
bd label add $ISSUE backend
stdout 'Added label'
bd comments add $ISSUE 'First comment' --author alice
stdout 'Comment added'

bd show $ISSUE
stdout 'Test issue for show'
stdout 'DESCRIPTION'
stdout 'backend'
stdout 'alice'

bd show $ISSUE --json
jq '.[0].issue.id'
stdout 'test-[a-z0-9]+'
jq '.[0].comments | length'
stdout '^1$'
jq '.[0].labels[0]'
stdout '"backend"'
